Your iPhone keyboard keys are way smaller than your actual fingertips, so how do you almost always hit the right letters, Techo Techies? ⌨️🤯

You’re watching: Tech Breakdowns

Save & Repost this Reel to uncover the hidden genius behind your touchscreen! 🔄

The Illusion of Touch:
The keys you see on your screen aren’t the actual hit targets you touch. Underneath every single letter lies a dynamic, invisible touch target zone that actively shifts size while you type!

How It Predicts Your Fingers:
If you type “t-i-m”, iOS knows the English language has words like “time”, not “timw”. Before your thumb even hits the glass:
• The invisible hit box around ‘e’ secretly inflates.
• Adjacent target z
